name: mainline_candidate_pool_audit_v1
status: complete: all 27 query selections, scores and routes reproduced; frozen pools scored
role: Post hoc coverage and query-selection diagnosis on all three previously completed nominal FactorShock streams; no new optimizer run or confirmation experiment.

shared_path_control.current_structural_local_noise: Shares the full structural query path and pools exactly; its terminal-only intervention adds no fourth search trajectory.
shared_path_control.initialization_only: Supplies the common ten paid initialization rows and initial incumbent; no adaptive pool.

frozen_assets.reuse: Load the original native prior and GP/structure bundle, including representations, likelihood, source integration, weights and covariance; replay only the saved own-arm raw observations. Do not refit, recalibrate or change source precision.

recovery.engine: Original complete V69 candidate generator, constrained TS and native proposal posterior, with original random streams and saved observation order.
recovery.simulator: No simulator call is permitted. A replayed selected policy must match the next saved policy before its already paid raw row is supplied.
recovery.generated_pool: Recover the actual generated proposal pools and routing/filtering stages exposed by the existing execution path; preserve policy coordinates, order and route. Report unrecoverable intermediate stages explicitly.
recovery.scored_pool: Recover the exact candidates presented to the selected backend, preserving order, acquisition scores and selected index. Do not add candidates or substitute a newly sampled pool.
recovery.prediction_snapshot: For each scored policy record objective/risk mean, constraint episode variance, constraint epistemic variance, posterior chance-violation probability and acquisition rank when available from the exact scoring call.
recovery.parity: All 27 selected policies must match the saved histories exactly. Check recorded score/route parity where historical traces exist; any mismatch remains a recovery failure and blocks truth scoring for the recovered experiment.
recovery.barrier: Finish and freeze every registered recovered path and its query parity before any new analytical truth evaluation. Do not inspect truth to repair replay or choose a subset of seeds.

truth_access.scope: Analytical f, g and episode-noise truth on the stable unique union of recovered generated/scored policies, actual terminal/recommendation policies and the fixed initial incumbent; the nominal geometry was already opened. Report recommendation-only policies separately: inclusion in a terminal or recommendation pool does not make a policy available in the actual query-action pool.
truth_access.cache_rule: Reuse matching physical-policy records from existing compatible nominal-geometry caches before evaluating missing truth. Deduplicate by integer policy coordinates, without new hashes or fingerprints.
truth_access.feasibility: g(x) + Phi_inverse(1-alpha) * sigma_g(x) <= 0, with the original target threshold and response scale.
truth_access.improvement: The objective f is minimized: a feasible policy improves when f is strictly lower than fixed initial policy0. Report objective reduction initial_f-f and quality gain (initial_f-f)/1.5 separately from actual deployed utility.
truth_access.restriction: Truth is diagnostic only, never a posterior update, candidate filter, acquisition score, model patch or new-seed selector.
truth_access.accounting: Record reused unique policies, newly evaluated unique policies and actual primitive f/g/sigma function calls separately; these analytical evaluations are not simulator observations.

comparisons: Coverage: feasible and feasible-improving counts and lowest objective in each generated and backend-scored pool; separate failures to generate from filtering out an available improvement. Report terminal/recommendation-only headroom separately from actual action-pool coverage.
Selection: whether the original selected policy is feasible-improving, its acquisition rank and true objective gap to the best feasible policy available in that same scored pool.

Prediction: risk mean error versus chance-margin/noise error and epistemic uncertainty for feasible improvements and selected policies; preserve the actual TS scores rather than replacing the query rule with terminal mean ranking.

Propagation: report predictions for candidates not observed at the scored checkpoint, and distinguish their coverage/ranking from already observed policies; fixed paths do not establish an adaptive cross-policy treatment effect.
Report all three seeds and all three actual backends, retaining local-noise as the shared structural search path. Existing terminal verification and deployed returns remain historical observations.

cost.new_truth_scoring: Only missing unique recovered policies after the recovery barrier; actual function calls and CPU recorded.
cost.replay: Preserve successful and failed recovery attempts and CPU/wall cost; no historical paid costs are charged again.

limitations: Three random streams on one already opened nominal geometry, with endogenous backend-specific pools; not a new-geometry test or a scientific superiority claim.
A true improvement in a rejected pool is post hoc headroom, not a policy the frozen optimizer actually found or independently verified.
Native and newer posteriors retain their existing representations and noise models; compare each backend against the pool it actually scored.

Internal larger alignment or uncertainty proposal pools before generator admission were not separately captured; coverage conclusions apply to recovered generator outputs, scored pools and recommendation unions.
